elements.name: Chromatic Warding
elements.desc: Starting at 5th level, you can channel your draconic essence to ward off harm. As an action, you gain immunity to the damage type associated with your chromatic ancestry for 1 minute. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Psionic Mind
elements.desc: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn't give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically.

elements.name: Gem Flight
elements.desc: Starting at 5th level, you can use a bonus action to manifest spectral wings on your body. These wings last for 1 minute. For the duration, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Metallic Breath Weapon
elements.desc: Starting at 5th level, you can use your action to exhale a secondary breath weapon. Choose one of the following options: Enervating Breath (15-foot cone; Constitution saving throw; failure = incapacitated until the end of its next turn) or Repulsion Breath (15-foot cone; Strength saving throw; failure = pushed 20 feet away from you and knocked prone). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Chromatic Dragonborn
elements.desc: Dragonborn with chromatic ancestry claim the raw elemental power of chromatic dragons. The vibrant colors of black, blue, green, red, and white dragons gleam in those dragonborn's scaled skin and in the deadly energy of their breath weapons. Theirs is the raw elemental fury of the volcano, of biting arctic winds, and of raging lightning storms, as well as the subtle whisper of swamp and forest, toxic and corrosive.

elements.name: Gem Dragonborn
elements.desc: Gem dragonborn partake of the heritage of gem dragons, who claim to be heirs of Sardior, the Ruby Dragon. The colors and mysterious powers of gem dragons—amethyst, crystal, emerald, sapphire, and topaz—gleam in their scaled skin and in the crystalline energy of their breath weapons. Theirs is the psionic power of the mind and the resilience of the earth.

elements.name: Metallic Dragonborn
elements.desc: Dragonborn with metallic ancestry lay claim to the tenacity of metallic dragons—brass, bronze, copper, gold, and silver—whose hues glint in their scales. Theirs is the fire of hearth and forge, the breath of the storm, and the enduring strength of the mountain.
